# External dependencies

`SLRT` is a reproducible sparse checkout created by `scripts/setup_upstream.sh` and ignored by the
parent repository. The required commit is
`38a4f7b00da7a858d59b7fabe5093876a84db8e0`. Do not place datasets or release checkpoints here.

The ELSC implementation uses and attributes CiCo APIs and metric behavior but does not assert a new
license for upstream files. Consult the upstream repository before redistribution.
